payload.question: plumb's judge asks: on 2026-10-17 you decided that some new requirements only added beside the rule 'every coding agent gets the same turn from plumb' and left it as it was. Today, because you removed the Pi adapter, that rule's host list changed from Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Hermes to Claude Code, Codex and Hermes, in its sentence and its example. Does your old decision still hold now that the list is shorter?
